name: Brain
greeting: Hi! I'm the GerarAI brain. Ask me about your portfolio, your investment theses or whatever you're looking at.

guide.header: {kind} guide · Read-only: it doesn't modify anything.
guide.insufficientBody: The available evidence does not allow a confirmed conclusion.
guide.emptyAnswerInsufficient: The assistant did not write a conclusion: the available evidence cannot confirm one. Check "Missing data" below to see if it says what is missing.
guide.emptyAnswer: The assistant returned the answer with no text: there is nothing to show as an answer. Check the sections and available sources below.
guide.emptySectionInsufficient: This section contains no text. The answer is marked as "Insufficient data" but does not say why this section is empty.
guide.emptySection: Section with no body: the assistant sent it empty. With no text there is nothing to read.
guide.missingRef: Reference with no available source: this citation cannot be verified.
guide.noCitations: No citations for this section: verify its claims before using them.
guide.missingEmpty: The assistant did not say what information is missing. You can ask for the data point and period you need to check.
guide.noSources: The assistant attached no sources. You cannot verify this answer from here.
